title: Merge-ready fixture issue
description:
## Issue Setup

- UAT Required: No

## Issue Goal

Exercise the merge lane dry-run decision path for an approved clean pull request.

## Why Now

Jade Symphony needs a credential-free way to rehearse merge readiness without calling live GitHub or merging a real PR.

## Issue Context

This issue is loaded by `examples/merge-fixture-workflow.md`. It is already in `Merging` and carries fixture linked pull request metadata for review decision, base branch, and mergeability.

## Decisions / Assumptions

### Decisions

- Keep this fixture dry-run only.
- Represent clean approval through normalized linked PR fixture metadata.

### Assumptions

- Empty fixture checks are acceptable for the first clean merge-lane rehearsal.

## Non-Negotiable Guardrails

- Do not perform a live merge from this fixture.
- Do not bypass real GitHub merge preflight in non-fixture mode.

## Scope

### In Scope

- Fixture-linked PR status conversion.
- Merge-ready dry-run decision reporting.

### Out of Scope

- Live PR fetching.
- Continuous merge polling.
- Closing real issues.

## Canonical References

### Target Repository / Package

- `Alive24/jade-symphony`

### Relevant Knowledge Sources

- `docs/dogfood-readiness.md`

### Relevant Code Paths

- `src/merge_lane.rs`
- `src/model.rs`
- `examples/merge-fixture-workflow.md`
- `examples/fixtures/merge-issues.json`

## Current State

Fixture linked PRs can now carry metadata needed for merge preflight rehearsal.

## Deliverable Shape

A `merge once --dry-run` report with a ready-to-merge decision and no mutation.

## Risks or Constraints

- Fixture readiness must not be treated as live approval.

## Expected Outcome

The dry-run merge lane reports a ready merge decision and prints dry-run actions only.

## Verification

### Completion Criteria

- `cargo run -- merge once examples/merge-fixture-workflow.md --dry-run` reports `ReadyToMerge`.

### Functional Verification

- `cargo test`
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`

### UAT

- Not required.

### Context Verification

- Confirm fixture mode remains separate from live merging.
